about.label: About
about.heading: Marketing, operations, and AI in the same brain.
about.paragraph1: I didn't trade marketing for code, I went deeper. Fifteen years leading marketing, events, and live marketing for brands like Jack Daniel's, Ambev, Red Bull, and Kwai, with teams of up to 100 people and over 1,000 events produced.
about.paragraph2: That repertoire of real operations is what now powers the AI I build: I understand the business bottleneck before designing the architecture.
about.paragraph3: I design and code autonomous agents, n8n automations, RAG, and SaaS products. Plus the creative layer with AI (image, video, content).
about.paragraph4: From briefing to deploy, without outsourcing execution.
